description: Exclusion phrasings in a character's own background flavor that rule a relation out (#580; FR-SCN-7): each family names the core predicate whose objects the character has none of, as an empty character-layer closed set over the character. A phrase counts only as a statement about the character: not after a determiner or possessive ('her only brother', 'the only child at the party'), and not before a preposition or relative clause that makes it a description of something else.
